html:
Home improvement services metro Atlanta

Build Heritage offers free, written, itemized quotes for home‑improvement work in metro Atlanta. You can choose from our eight trades and receive a response within one business day.

How the process works

  1. Complete the quote form or email info@buildheritage.org.
  2. We reply within one business day with a detailed estimate.
  3. Select the trades you need—painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, packing & moving, or roofing & tiles.
  4. We schedule the work at a convenient time.
  5. Licensed and insured Georgia contractors finish the project.

What you can expect

  • Trades available: Packing & moving, painting, drywall, flooring & vinyl, framing, doors, window & door trim, roofing & tiles.
  • Cost guide (August 2026):
  • Full roof replacement: $9,000–$20,000
  • Whole‑home interior repaint: $3,000–$8,000
  • Financial advice: Keep 10–15 % of the quoted amount aside for hidden issues.
  • Coverage area: Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, Columbus.
  • Credentials: Licensed and insured in Georgia.

FAQ

How long does it take to receive a quote? You will receive a written, itemized quote within one business day of contacting us.

Are you licensed and insured? Yes, we are licensed and insured in Georgia.

Can I request only one of the eight trades? Yes. You can select any combination of the trades we provide.

What if I need work in a different metro‑Atlanta city? We serve all the listed cities, including Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, and others—see the full list on our service‑areas page.

How do I start the process? Submit a request through our quote form or email us at info@buildheritage.org.

Get your free itemized quote now
